SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.33 (12 Oct 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 1265)
APO 500
12 October 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Evacuees from Bonin Islands.
1. Reference is made to:
a. Memorandum from the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file AG 014.33 (20 Sep 46)GC, (SCAPIN-1221) dated 20 September 1946, subject: Repatriation of Evacuees from Bonin Islands.
b. Memorandum from the Central Liaison Office, Number 5175(RF), dated 7 October 1946, subject as above.
2. The authorization for repatriation of Rogers Savory and Roy Gilley, as authorized by reference 1 a above, is hereby cancelled.
3. Baggage allowance authorized for above named individuals may be carried by their family members.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
